name: ModelVariant120_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant120_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the slot ambient dims while a flickering sprite follows the camera part and 16 spinning blades of shaded strips turn around it, then both grow in front of the slot and fade while a full-screen flash fades out and the ambient recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, packs one texture image and, for requests from 100 up, queues a tint, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start, 1 once when it starts, 0 while it runs and 2 once the ambient is restored; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-137 and 267 images build it from the same source with the PAL flash height and the US data layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
